nodes.text: Enter Niuzao Catacombs at the marked entrance in Townlong Steppes.

recovery.text: If the pin appears above or below you, use the outdoor entrance and follow the upper right passage. Do not infer a quest prerequisite from the nearby quest enemy.

destination.label: Niuzao Catacombs entrance
destination.directions: Enter the cave behind the area where Yul Wildpaw appears. Outdoor arrows stop at the entrance.

nodes.text: Inside the catacombs, take the rising passage on the right near the lower pool. Follow its right branch to Huggalon’s upper alcove.

recovery.text: If the pin appears above or below you, use the outdoor entrance and follow the upper right passage. Do not infer a quest prerequisite from the nearby quest enemy.

destination.label: Huggalon upper alcove
destination.directions: Continue through the catacombs. Near the lower pool, take the rising passage on the right, then its right branch. Huggalon is in the upper alcove; do not continue through the opening toward the lower quest enemy.

nodes.text: Defeat Huggalon the Heart Watcher and loot B. F. F. Necklace. He may appear neutral; a kill alone does not finish this step.

recovery.text: If Huggalon is absent, his next appearance is unknown. Choose another activity rather than following a guessed timer. If combat is unsafe, bring help or defer. Check the corpse and bag space after a kill.

recovery.text: If the item is missing, check bags, bank and mail. Toy Box ownership, rather than this guide cursor or the kill, completes the goal.
